scope: Monochrome Ready controls, dock and full-height library catalog.
behavior: Controls, surfaces, text, focus and launch progress use neutral gray values; source artwork and game icons retain their colors.
Library starts at y20 in the dock; the separate controller brand and library count row are removed.
Cached running-game icons counter-flip CGImage drawing in the flipped canvas, preserving aspect ratio.
The native catalog viewport spans full window height. Top spacing scrolls with the document; cards pass behind persistent header and error text.
Layer-backed AppKit views own scrolling transforms; a transparent Metal chrome sublayer appears above card layers. No footer space is reserved when no error is displayed.
Card pointer targets exclude toolbar/error text areas; controller reveal returns the first row to scroll offset zero.
limits: The cached running-game icon branch was checked with an owned asymmetric test image; this turn did not relaunch a real game to inspect its overlay.
No new gameplay FPS, frame-time or generalized game-compatibility claim is made.
